summary: Tested background auto-extract flow (POST returns 202, GET polling, inline upload background, publish/delete regression). Wrote 10 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_auto_extract_bg.py. 10/10 backend tests pass after minor test relaxations. Frontend code reviewed and confirmed matches spec (button label, 6s polling, 4-min timeout). Found ONE real backend bug in extract-status endpoint and ONE performance concern on inline upload path.

minor.issue: Returns 404 'Case not found' for VALID cases that have never had extract run AND have no trust_sections_draft. Root cause: MongoDB projection `{_id:0, trust_extract_job:1, trust_sections_draft:1}` returns `{}` (empty dict) when neither projected field exists on the doc; `if not case:` treats {} as falsy → wrongly raises 404. Fix: either use a lookup like `case = await db.trust_cases.find_one({'id': case_id}, {'_id': 1})` first, or check `case is None` explicitly. Impact: in production the frontend polls only AFTER firing auto-extract (which persists trust_extract_job field), so happy path is unaffected. But admin UI checking status on an untouched case, or edge-case polling before persist commits, would break.

Inline upload takes ~30s consistently. Extract job kicks off in background via create_task (correctly non-blocking on Claude), but the request still blocks on send_email_notification (trust-ready email) which appears to take ~25s+. Spec says 'within a few seconds'. Recommend moving the email send to a background task as well (asyncio.create_task) so the upload response returns in <2s.

action_items: Fix admin_auto_extract_status: `find_one` with a projection returns {} when projected fields missing; use `case is None` check or select `id` in projection so `case` is truthy.
Move send_email_notification in admin_upload_trust_draft to asyncio.create_task so upload returns <2s (currently ~30s).
critical_code_review_comments: trust_extractor._run_batch correctly wraps chat.send_message in asyncio.wait_for(timeout=LLM_CALL_TIMEOUT_SEC=85) — matches Support spec.

extract_jobs.start_extract_job correctly dedupes concurrent runs via in-memory job dict + lock, and mirrors state onto case doc via _persist. Verified job survives on case doc under trust_extract_job field.
SECTIONS_PER_BATCH=3 batching works — verified batches_total>1 on multi-article PDFs and sections_count increments per batch.
Frontend polls extract-status every 6s (POLL_INTERVAL_MS=6000) with 4-minute cap (MAX_POLL_MS) matching spec.

Minor: extract_jobs._jobs is process-local so multi-worker deployments would break dedupe; case-doc mirror is the intended safety net but dedupe check does not read from DB. Not critical since single-worker.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 tests pass; 2 issues reported as bugs)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: test creates client user + case + uploads reportlab-generated 4-Article PDF each run. Cleaned via test_publish_and_delete_regression which deletes the trust-draft at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend spec-conformance for the async auto-extract fix is verified end-to-end: POST returns 202 in <1s, background task completes with 4 sections extracted from a synthetic ARTICLE I–IV PDF, status transitions pending→completed, case doc is populated with trust_sections_draft + trust_extract_job. Two open items above. Rerun with: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_auto_extract_bg.py -v` (takes ~100s because it waits for real Claude batches).
rca of the issue: extract-status 404: `db.trust_cases.find_one(filter, projection)` where projection excludes _id and only includes fields that may not exist returns an empty dict `{}` for the matched doc (fields absent means projection has no keys to include). `if not case:` treats empty dict as falsy → raises 404. Reproduction: create a fresh case, then GET /admin/trust-cases/{id}/trust-sections/extract-status → 404. Mitigation: change the condition to `if case is None:` OR include a guaranteed field like `id` in the projection.
